method: Every open PR in the seven organ repositories, read from the GitHub API with pagination on 2026-09-30. Per PR: commits ahead/behind the default branch, git merge-tree conflict check, and the PR body. Claims that main already carries an effect cite the file checked on main.
coverage: PR bodies summarized, not every diff reviewed line by line; a disposition is a proposal for founder review, never a merge or close
findings: SECURITY: PumpStation main accepts a replayable wallet login (constant signed message, no nonce or expiry); the fix is PumpStation #16 (clean merge)
One-spine gap: DALEOBANKS main still carries local ledger, heartbeat, raw vault and constitution modules; the swap PRs (#58/#59) depend on an unmerged kernel branch (kernel #16)
WMI's July control-plane stack (#17-#24) would be a second authority plane if merged as is
Four overlapping RailScout founder-intent installs (#2-#5) of the same 2026-08-19 conversation

propagation_receipt.follow_up_owner: founder merges or declines each draft; next agent reruns the anti-context-loss test
